title: Machine Learning Advanced Concepts - Module #17925
question: What is the purpose of the self-attention mechanism in Transformer architectures?
options: It allows the model to dynamically weigh the relevance of different tokens in a sequence relative to one another, regardless of distance.
It automatically prunes low-importance input variables from the dataset.
It computes accuracy metrics using a parallel clustered matrix.
It locks the weight parameters of the neural network during backward propagation.
answer: It allows the model to dynamically weigh the relevance of different tokens in a sequence relative to one another, regardless of distance.
explanation: Self-attention evaluates the relationship of all words in a sentence at once. This solves long-range dependency limitations in traditional architectures like RNNs.
